relationships.desc: 魔法系的双子星，在战斗中默契配合冰火联合技
同为符文学派出身，凯尔走火系泽菲尔走雷系
在悬浮城邦阿瓦隆相识，音乐与符文的美学共鸣
科技系双核，诺瓦负责硬件赛弗负责软件
曾并肩作战于机械军团围攻，铁壁信赖星核的技术
赛弗的智力与阿特拉斯的耐力形成完美防御体系
神灵系双壁，圣女与战圣在信仰中互相激励
恶魔系两个反英雄，在黑暗中互相理解彼此的挣扎
瑞文在奥萝拉的圣光中找到了一丝人性的慰藉
两人都与死亡之力有关，命运丝线与亡灵之力互相呼应
野性之力与肉体极限的较量，谁才是最强战士？
速度型搭档，兽牙的爆发力配合疾风的隐匿性
两个被世界排斥的存在，在彼此身上找到理解
来自星际的两人，在异乡互相依靠共同寻找归属
矛与盾的永恒较量，互相激励突破极限
影曾教导泰坦如何在战斗中运用隐匿技巧
血焰与圣焰的对立吸引，在战斗中互相试探
两个感知型英雄，心灵感应与命运预知互相增强
冰霜旋律与神圣光辉的共鸣，如姐妹般亲密
符文与星辰的研究交流，共同探索能量本质
凯尔追求的终极魔法境界正是奈克萨斯所守护的禁忌
赛弗的黑客技术与AI核心的全域控制是终极对决
神圣光辉是混沌碎片最恐惧的存在
瑞文本是魔王军团的棋子，叛逃后被追杀至今
两位命运操控者的对决——谁编织的命运更真实？
方恩体内的十二基因都源自起源兽的基因碎片
奥利安代表的星辰与虚空帝王代表的虚无是对立面
布雷兹是武道之神选中的继承者候选人
莉莉丝的母亲当年正是被黑暗契约者出卖的
影忍一族的灭族者正是暗影刺客组织
诺瓦的纳米技术源自欧米茄协议的泄漏数据
命运编织者早已预见索林的诸神黄昏
魔王入侵地球是为了逃避深渊中苏醒的死亡起源
AI核心原是欧米茄协议的子系统，觉醒后独立
万法之源与原初混沌是秩序与混沌的永恒对立
命运编织者试图编织死亡的命运，但死亡不可被编织
进化体是起源兽基因碎片的直接产物
恶魔将军与地狱之门守卫共同指挥深渊入侵
虚空帝王是外星帝王暗中效忠的终极存在
武道之神在永恒角斗士身上测试武道的极限

kael.pickQuote: The seven flames answer to me. Let's burn bright.
kael.battleStart: Time to show them what real fire looks like!
kael.skillUltimate: INFERNO DESCENDS! Witness the apocalypse of fire!
kael.takeDamage: Hah! Is that all you've got?
kael.victory: The flames never lie. And they say we won.
kael.defeat: The fire... it's going out... I can't...
kael.idle: You know, controlling seven types of flame simultaneously is actually a great party trick.

lyra.pickQuote: My melody shall freeze their hearts... literally.
lyra.battleStart: Shall we begin? The audience is waiting.
lyra.skillActive: Listen closely... this is your lullaby.
lyra.skillUltimate: Eternal winter movement! Let the final note echo forever!
lyra.victory: A standing ovation would be nice, but victory will do.
lyra.idle: Do you think ice crystals have a favorite musical key? I think it's D minor.

zephyr.pickQuote: Rune circuits online. Ready to shock the system.
zephyr.battleStart: Let me draw a little something on the battlefield.
zephyr.skillUltimate: THUNDER PRISON! No escape from ten thousand volts!
zephyr.victory: Another system successfully hacked. With lightning.
zephyr.idle: Fun fact: my mechanical arms short-circuit when I sneeze. It's embarrassing.

nova.pickQuote: Nanobots synced. Let me rebuild this battlefield.
nova.battleStart: Analyzing threat level. Time to upgrade our approach.
nova.skillActive: Blade arms deployed — cutting edge technology!
nova.takeDamage: Armor integrity at 60%. Still plenty of me left.
nova.victory: Another successful field test. The data is incredible.
nova.idle: The nanobots get bored easily. Right now they're building tiny sculptures inside my arm.

cipher.pickQuote: Zero protocol initialized. I am already inside.
cipher.battleStart: Connection established. Their systems are mine.
cipher.skillActive: Neural breach — you work for me now.
cipher.skillUltimate: FULL SYSTEM OVERRIDE! Every machine bows to zero!
cipher.idle: I've been alive in seventeen different simulated realities this morning. Tuesday.

atlas.pickQuote: Iron Wall standing by. Nothing gets past me.
atlas.skillUltimate: IRON FORTRESS MODE! Attack me! ALL OF YOU!
atlas.takeDamage: Armor holding. I've had worse from training dummies.
atlas.victory: Shield integrity: zero scratches. You're welcome.
atlas.idle: 70% metal, 30% human, 100% stubborn. The doctors couldn't explain the math either.

aurora.pickQuote: The light has not faded. I am here to protect.
aurora.battleStart: May dawn's light guide us through the darkness.
aurora.skillActive: Spear of dawn — purify this evil!
aurora.skillUltimate: HEAVENLY JUDGMENT! Let the light of paradise descend!
aurora.takeDamage: I can bear this pain. Others cannot.
aurora.victory: No one had to die today. That is the true victory.
aurora.defeat: The light... please... don't let it go out... not yet...
aurora.idle: I tried to understand human fashion once. I still don't get why shoes need heels.

thorin.pickQuote: My hammer thirsts! Point me at the biggest one!
thorin.battleStart: HAHA! Finally, a fight worth my time!
thorin.skillActive: HAMMER FALL! Feel the wrath of thunder!
thorin.skillUltimate: RAGNAROK UNLEASHED! I BECOME THE STORM ITSELF!
thorin.takeDamage: HA! That tickled! Give me more!
thorin.victory: ANOTHER VICTORY FOR THE THUNDER! DRINKS ON ME!
thorin.defeat: The storm... fades... but thunder... echoes... forever...
thorin.idle: Last week I accidentally destroyed a vending machine. It looked at me funny. No regrets.

raven.pickQuote: I walk between worlds. Don't follow unless you want to die.
raven.battleStart: The shadows are hungry tonight. Feed them.
raven.skillActive: Shadow claws — let me taste your soul.
raven.skillUltimate: ABYSS GATE OPEN! Every sin you've committed reaches for you!
raven.takeDamage: Hmph. I've felt worse from my own demons.
raven.victory: Another soul harvested. But not yours... not tonight.
raven.defeat: The shadows... they're calling me home... not this time...
raven.idle: The demon inside me has opinions about everything. Mostly negative. Currently it hates your shoes.

lilith.pickQuote: Blood and fire, baby. Let me paint the town red.
lilith.battleStart: Ooh, fresh canvas! Let's make some art with pain.
lilith.skillActive: Blood roses bloom! Isn't it beautiful, darling?
lilith.skillUltimate: GARDEN OF BLOOD! Every petal is a kiss of death!
lilith.victory: Darling, you should've run when you had the chance.
lilith.defeat: The blood... mine... it's so... cold...
lilith.idle: People say I have a dark sense of humor. I say they haven't seen my garden at midnight.

morrigan.pickQuote: I've already seen how this ends. Let me show you.
morrigan.battleStart: The threads are clear. Your fate is... complicated.
morrigan.skillActive: Your strings are mine to pull now.
morrigan.skillUltimate: FINAL THREAD SEVERED! Destiny ends HERE!
morrigan.victory: The threads weave victory. As I always knew they would.
morrigan.defeat: Even my sight... cannot see beyond... this ending...
morrigan.idle: Tomorrow you'll have coffee, argue with a stranger, and find 20 credits on the ground. You're welcome.

hollow.pickQuote: Death refused me. So I command it instead.
hollow.battleStart: Rise, my servants. We have an appointment with the living.
hollow.skillUltimate: UNDEAD SCOURGE! Every corpse in this city is MY soldier!
hollow.takeDamage: Pain is just a memory. I don't have those anymore.
hollow.victory: The dead have spoken. They say we won.
hollow.defeat: Finally... true rest... after all these... centuries...
hollow.idle: The ghosts around me are complaining about the wifi signal again. Even in death, no peace.

fang.pickQuote: Twelve predators. One hunter. Let's go.
fang.battleStart: I can smell your fear. Delicious.
fang.skillActive: BEAST FORM! Claws out, fangs down!
fang.skillUltimate: FULL APEX PREDATOR! Twelve genes become ONE!
fang.takeDamage: RAAGH! That just made me angry!
fang.victory: The hunt is over. I always catch my prey.
fang.defeat: The beast within... it's taking over... no... not again...
fang.idle: On a scale of one to ten, my urge to howl at the moon right now is an eleven.

spore.pickQuote: The mycelium network is listening. And so am I.
spore.battleStart: Shall we see what grows from this battlefield?
spore.skillActive: Spore cloud deployed. Breathe deep... or don't.
spore.skillUltimate: FUNGAL DOMINION! Let nature reclaim everything!
spore.defeat: The mycelium... goes silent... the forest... forgets me...
spore.idle: Technically I'm a walking ecosystem. Currently hosting 47 species of fungi. They have names.

psyche.pickQuote: I already know what you're thinking. Don't bother.
psyche.battleStart: Your mind is an open book. Let me rewrite it.
psyche.skillActive: PSYCHIC STORM! Get out of my head!
psyche.skillUltimate: ABYSS OF MIND! Face your deepest terror!
psyche.takeDamage: That... was loud. My head is louder now.
psyche.victory: I could read their victory speech. It was very cliché.
psyche.defeat: Too many voices... can't... find mine... anymore...
psyche.idle: Everyone around here is thinking about lunch. Except Titan. He's thinking about punching things.

orion.pickQuote: Stars guide my path. I will not be lost again.
orion.battleStart: By the light of a thousand suns, we fight.
orion.skillUltimate: STAR RIVER CASCADE! The cosmos fights alongside us!
orion.takeDamage: A star does not dim from a single blow.
orion.victory: The constellations align in victory. Home feels closer now.
orion.defeat: My light... fading... but the stars... remember...
orion.idle: Earth gravity is so heavy. On my world we just... float. I miss floating sometimes.

vega.pickQuote: I weave light itself. Try to keep up.
vega.battleStart: A new design requires new materials. You'll do.
vega.skillActive: Photon blades — let me cut you a new look!
vega.skillUltimate: LIGHT WEAVE COMPLETE! You're trapped in my masterpiece!
vega.takeDamage: My form flickers... how dare you damage the design!
vega.victory: Perfection achieved. As always. You're welcome.
vega.defeat: The light... dims... my masterpiece... unfinished...
vega.idle: I redesigned three combat suits this morning. The fourth one can literally walk through walls. Fashion.

blaze.pickQuote: My fists don't negotiate. Let's talk with knuckles.
blaze.battleStart: Twelve rounds. I won't need more than one.
blaze.skillUltimate: ONE PUNCH. ONE WORLD. ONE ME!
blaze.victory: And the crowd goes WILD! That's championship form!
blaze.idle: I bench-press trucks for fun. The gym banned me after the third incident. Understandable.

shadow.pickQuote: You won't see me. You won't hear me. You'll just... lose.
shadow.skillUltimate: SHADOW REALM DESCENDS. Welcome to my world.
shadow.idle: ...No, I won't show you my face. ...No, I don't eat in front of people. ...Yes, I'm annoyed.

titan.pickQuote: I don't need powers. I AM the power.
titan.battleStart: Everyone stay back. This one's mine.
titan.skillActive: GROUND POUND! Feel the earth SHAKE!
titan.skillUltimate: ABSOLUTE DOMAIN! NOTHING. MOVES. BUT ME!
titan.takeDamage: I didn't feel that. I never feel anything.
titan.victory: Still standing. As always. As I always will.
titan.idle: Doctors say I should feel pain. I tried once. Overrated. Recommend the numbness instead.

archmage_nexus.encounter: Foolish mortals. I have mastered EVERY school of magic. What do you have?
archmage_nexus.attack: Witness the culmination of all magical knowledge — OBLIVION!
archmage_nexus.death: Impossible... my infinite mana... it wasn't... enough...?

omega_protocol.encounter: YOU CANNOT DEFEAT EVOLUTION. I AM THE FINAL FORM OF TECHNOLOGY.
omega_protocol.attack: ALL WEAPON SYSTEMS — MAXIMUM OUTPUT! RESISTANCE IS ILLOGICAL!
omega_protocol.death: SYSTEM FAILURE... CASCADING... THIS WAS NOT... IN MY CALCULATIONS...

chaos_god_fragment.encounter: Order is a LIE. I am the truth that existed before your universe was born.
chaos_god_fragment.attack: RETURN TO CHAOS! LET EVERYTHING UNMAKE ITSELF!
chaos_god_fragment.death: You delay the inevitable... chaos always... returns... always...

demon_king.encounter: YOU THINK YOU FACE A DEMON? I AM THE ABYSS INCARNATE!
demon_king.attack: SOUL ANNIHILATION! YOUR VERY EXISTENCE IS MY PLAYTHING!
demon_king.death: My legions... will never stop... the abyss... remembers... ALL...

fate_weaver.encounter: I have woven your defeat since before you were born. How quaint that you resist.
fate_weaver.attack: YOUR THREAD ENDS HERE. I CUT IT WITH MY OWN HANDS.
fate_weaver.death: The tapestry... unravels... but new threads... will always... emerge...

origin_beast.attack: EVOLVE OR PERISH! THIS IS THE LAW OF ALL LIVING THINGS!
origin_beast.death: The cycle... continues... I will... grow again... from... nothing...

void_emperor.encounter: I have watched universes die. Yours will be... unremarkable.
void_emperor.attack: EXISTENCE DENIED. Your universe's subscription has expired.
void_emperor.death: How... curious. Something I did not... anticipate. ...Fascinating.

god_of_martial.encounter: A THOUSAND YEARS I HAVE WAITED FOR WORTHY CHALLENGERS. SHOW ME YOUR LIMIT!
god_of_martial.attack: ULTIMATE MARTIAL ART — HEAVEN PIERCING FIST!
god_of_martial.death: FINALLY... A FIGHT... THAT MADE ME FEEL... ALIVE...

tech_tyrant.encounter: Your primitive organic bodies cannot comprehend TRUE POWER.
tech_tyrant.attack: WEAPON MATRIX — FULL SALVO! LET ME SHOW YOU WAR PERFECTED!
tech_tyrant.death: My empire... of steel... crumbles to... rust...

death_lord.encounter: KNEEL BEFORE YOUR KING! EVERY SOUL IN THIS CITY ALREADY BELONGS TO ME!
death_lord.attack: UNDEAD APOCALYPSE! RISE AND SERVE YOUR TRUE MASTER!
death_lord.death: My throne... of bones... scattered... the dead... are free...

mothership_core.encounter: PLANETARY ASSAULT INITIATED. RESISTANCE FACTOR: NEGLIGIBLE.
mothership_core.death: CORE BREACH... CONTAINMENT... FAILING... MISSION... ABORT...
